description: §19.10.6 positive — `transactions="concurrent"` on a Postgres database is the ruled opt-in: each transaction runs on its own reserved pool connection instead of waiting behind the database's one-at-a-time rule. It compiles clean: no E-SQL-010, and no W-ATTR-002 (the value is recognized).
rationale: §19.10.6 (ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S449 item C — "keep (b) as a possible opt in when adopters use PG"): on a `<program>` whose `db=` names a Postgres or MySQL database, `transactions="concurrent"` SHALL lift the one-at-a-time rule for that database.
